comparison.objective: Install an arch keystone before removing wooden centering; unlike shock-absorber commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and insert a wedge-shaped load-bearing stone, then remove temporary support; no fine fastener engagement or dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Arch must remain standing after centering removal, implying correct keystone installation. Numeric stability/tolerance details and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests structural sequencing and load-bearing insertion rather than impact-response calibration.
